Search and Use Our Permitting System
Click on the Search button above to find Applications/Permits. You can then use the tabs in the detail screen to see the Reviews, Inspections, Status, Fees and much more. This is also where you can interact with the Application/Permit (paying any outstanding fees and scheduling inspections for example). The Resources menu gives you access to additional information and services. You can get access to much of our data by using the options in the Reports menu.

Sign Up and Get eNotified
We'll notify you when there has been a Review, Inspection or a change in the Application/Permit Status. You can sign up for this free service by adding them in your Account or by using the "Add to eNotification" button when you are looking at the details of an Application/Permit.

*Don't Let Your Application Expire*
The expiration date automatically appears on the application after all reviewing departments have completed their first reviews.

Be Aware:
It is your responsibility to monitor the expiration date.

Some applications can't be extended.

If an application expires - You may have to reapply!

Pre-Application Services

Pierce County offers Pre-Application Services to provide early guidance and help customers prepare stronger permit applications. Options include a meeting with staff reviewers, a written report, and redlined plan comments, all tailored to your project.

Learn more at PierceCountyWa.gov/PreAppServices.

Predesigned Project Guides

Save time and money on common projects! Choose from predesigned plans with no engineer or architect required for decks, carports, covered porches and garages.

Design to your specifications using one of our fillable forms, then submit with your residential construction application and a site plan. Visit PierceCountyWa.gov/ResidentialPermits to learn more.

Online Development Guide

Kick off your project with our Online Development Guide. Use this customized research tool to better understand site constraints, zoning information, and permitting requirements for your project.

2026 Fee Adjustments

Annual permitting fee adjustments take effect Feb. 1, 2026. To avoid higher fees, complete applications must be submitted and paid for before the effective date. Applications vest at time of payment, not submittal.

Pierce County anticipates a high volume of applications. Customers are strongly encouraged to apply by Jan. 16, 2026.

Learn more about the fee changes at PierceCountyWa.gov/RateFeeChanges.

Lobby Service Changes
Starting June 1, the Development Center Lobby will continue to be open Monday-Friday, 9 a.m.-2 p.m., but in-person technical assistance will only be available on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. This change gives technical reviewers more uninterrupted time to focus on application reviews and move your project to approval. Read the full update here.
